The good news is that we still have the prospect of a full T20 game tomorrow, weather permitting, and that's surely the only proper way for this tournament to end. Join us once again when we resume our coverage tomorrow, and hopefully we'll have a corker of a final that's worth all the waiting we've endured. Until then, good night!

 For innings of rescheduled length of 10 or more over overs, no bowler may bowl more than one-fifth of the total overs allowed. Where the total overs is not divisible by 5, one additional over shall be allowed to the maximum number per bowler necessary to make up the balance.

6pm After 73 games, including three knockout matches, in IPL 2023, we're back to where we started: MS Dhoni's Chennai Super Kings vs Hardik Pandya's Gujarat Titans in Ahmedabad. Dhoni will be featuring in his 250th IPL game. Will it be his last dance? He has been hobbling on one good leg this IPL, and will turn 42 this July, but you never know with him. He will probably turn up next year and will beat the odds once again with just one good leg.

On the other side is Dhoni's protégé - and future India captain - Hardik. He had inspired Titans to beat the odds in their first IPL season in 2022, and now is his chance to make Gujarat remember the Titans. I'm Deivarayan Muthu and I'll be joined by Karthik Krishnaswamy to take you through the thrills and spills. Sit back and relax. Remember to put the tray tables in the upright and locked position.

Sai: "Csk have got to a flying start but the problem with this chase is they need to keep going at the same rate for the rest of the chase. A tough ask no mater what given the pressure of chasing in a finals. Still advantage GT at this stage"

Srikumar M Meno: "What happens to those dudes who paint themselves in their team colours, when a match goes into the reserve day? Do they doff their paint, have a shower and repaint on the second day, or do they sleep with their paints on?"

commentary: full on off stump, once again too full for elevation. Driven down to the left of long-on, and Gaikwad is interested in a second but Conway sends him back

wrong'un, dangled across Gaikwad and pitching outside off before turning further away. Don't know if he picked it, and if he did he's been done in the air by some dip. Looks to go over long-on, ends up getting a top-edge that skews high in the air before Rashid settles under it at backward point
dismissal: RD Gaikwad c Rashid Khan b Noor Ahmad 26 (30m 16b 3x4 1x6) SR: 162.5

commentary: wrong'un, full and turning in from off stump, gets forward and clips to deep backward square leg
pre_text:
In walks Shivam Dube. He was bowled by Noor in Qualifier 1. Dube is CSK's impact player, replacing Matheesha Pathirana.

Tallfred: "Is it Chennai Supersopper Kings now? "

commentary: another wrong'un, pitching just short of driving length outside off. Looks to chip to long-off's right, I think, and it turns in and hits the inside half of the bat, and he ends up chipping to long-off's left
another wrong'un, ends up a long way down the leg side this time, eluding Conway's sweep

Noor bags his second of the over. What an over. Back of a length, and this one turns away from Conway, and it stops on him as well. Lets out a yell of frustration after mishitting it straight down long-off's throat. Was probably looking to hit it over extra-cover off the back foot, not an easy shot to play at all
dismissal: DP Conway c Sharma b Noor Ahmad 47 (34m 25b 4x4 2x6) SR: 188

commentary: short, gets up to shoulder height over off stump. Pulled in the air, but lands dafely in front of Noor running to his right from deep square leg
pre_text: Ajinkya Rahane walks in at No. 4, with 93 required from 48 balls. Little to continue to Dube.

commentary: Now he goes short at Rahane, and he doesn't middle his pull at all. Checks his shot and picks up two, since the fielder has to run in a long way from deep midwicket
pre_text: Rahane began the season in absolutely blistering ball-striking form. He's cooled off a little since then. Will he bring his A game to the final.

commentary: walloped. Little slants this back-of-a-length ball across Rahane, finishing just outside off, and he just stands there and baseballs it over the midwicket boundary. Somewhere in between a horizontal-bat and a straight-bat shot
full outside off, punched to extra-cover
pre_text: Deep backward square leg, deep midwicket, long-on, deep cover point and deep third are the fielders back for Rahane.

commentary: is this the shot of the match? Half-volley on off stump, but how sweet was the timing? Just gets his front leg out of the way and extends his arms through a straight-bat drive to launch it effortlessly over the straight long-off boundary
short now, gets up to chest height, pulled along the ground towards deep midwicket
full stock ball turns down the leg side, and Rahane, looking to flick, overbalances a little and leaves the crease, but Saha fumbles it. Missed stumping?
pre_text: Titans still ahead on win probability according to our predictor. 63.07%, apparently. Noor to finish his quota now. Left-arm over as always.

commentary: length ball turning in from an off-stumpish line. Presses forward  and dabs into the off side to bring Dube on strike
back of a length, flat, straightens close to off stump, punched to long-off
pre_text: The umpires have called for a ball change. Not sure why they're changing the ball - has it gotten too damp?

commentary: back of a length close to off stump. Looks to make room and cut, and gets a thick edge that rolls towards short third

short_text: Noor Ahmad to Dube, no run
commentary: beats him with turn. Flat length ball fairly wide of off stump, and Dube was looking to make a bit of room and crash it over long-off, probably. Beats his outside edge, and Saha whips off the bails. He hasn't lifted his back foot or dragged it out, though
fullish on off stump, clipped down to long-on

short_text: Noor Ahmad to Rahane, no run
commentary: quickish wrong'un, pitching outside leg, and Noor finishes with figures of 2-17 in three overs after Rahane misses the flick and gets hit on the pad. Superb bowling in difficult circumstances in a massive, massive game
back of a length, straightens towards middle stump. Gets his front leg out of the way and muscles it along the ground to deep midwicket
pre_text: Rashid returns. Right-arm over.

commentary: steps out, and Rashid widens his line. Looks to hit over extra-cover, and gets a thick edge that loops up and lands to the right of short third

Clears his front leg to go over long-on, but Rashid fires this too full for that. Thick inside edge dribbles out into the square leg region, and there's no one in the circle there. Rashid gives chase himself, and the batters sneak a quick second run

Dube isn't in rhythm just yet. Quickish and fairly full, turning from leg stump towards his cleared front leg. Inside half of the bat as he looks to go big, and the ball lands well short of long-on, to his left
wrong'un, turns down leg, and Rahane sinks onto his back knee quickly and sweeps it away to the left of short fine leg

four more! Similar shot, more of a kneeling pull than a proper sweep, and again he hits the wrong'un to the left of short fine. Deep backward square leg gives chase to his right and puts in a full-length dive, but it's in vain
back of a length, angling away from off stump, flat-batted along the ground to the right of long-on
pre_text: 30 balls, 59 runs. Rahane is on 26 off 11. Here comes Mohit Sharma, who's looked unhittable in so many games this season. Over the wicket to the left-hander.

commentary: slower ball on the pads, clipped to the left of short fine leg. No pace to work with at all
pre_text:
Raj Patel : "Fiancée supporting GT .. mom supporting CSK … not sure how good my sleep tonight is going to be .. hahah "

Panda: "Take Noor's spell out and CSK have scored 91 in 7 overs. Brilliant Bowling."

commentary: slower ball slanting away from the left-hander and landing wide of off stump. Dube is in position for the big hit weeks before thre ball reaches him, and in the end he just lets the ball hit his bat, bewildered, and the ball loops over the bowler's head and lands roughly where he began his run-up
goes short and into the pitch, offcutter finishing chest high just outside off. Pulled along the ground to deep midwicket

gone. Mohit's lack of pace gets another wicket. Back of a length, outside off, it's there for the slash over point in everry way except it's the back-of-the-hand slowie. Stops on Rahane, and he ends up punching it in the air and straight to the man at deep point
dismissal: AM Rahane c Shankar b Sharma 27 (20m 13b 2x4 2x6) SR: 207.69

commentary: quick length ball nipping in towards middle stump, and Rayudu gets forward for a punch to long-on
pre_text: Ambati Rayudu walks in for the final time in the IPL with CSK needing 54 off 25 balls. This is still doable, but it needs doing immediately.

commentary: short outside off, turns away further. Pulled along the ground to deep midwicket
pre_text: Rashid.

commentary: flat length ball straightening from an off-stumpish line. Looks to go over the top, but loses his shape and ends up dragging it to deep midwicket, all along the floor

short_text: Rashid Khan to Rayudu, no run
commentary: quick legbreak outside off, goes back and punches it back to the bowler
full now, too full to get underneath, driven along the ground to long-off

finally, Dube finds some rhythm. Wrong'un, turning away from off stump, and it lands just a touch too full from Rashid. It's in Dube's arc, and he clears his front leg, keeps his head still, and hits it clean and flat over the straight long-on boundary

six more. Dube has arrived alright. This is a legbreak straightening towards off stump, and again it's in Dube's hitting arc. Clears that front leg again, and hits this one higher but just as cleanly, all the way over long-on
trademark Rayudu shot. Mohit bowls a rare slot ball. It's a slower ball but it's the wrong length, and Rayudu steps leg side to create hitting room, and launches it high over long-off
pre_text: Here's Mohit once again.

commentary: Four more, and Rayudu is finishing in style. Another error from Mohit. Full-toss outside off, and Rayudu lashes it to the right of the diving extra-cover fielder

terrific shot. Stunning. Back of a length outside off, and Rayudu sits on the back foot, deep in his crease, and launches it with a  straight bat over the long-off boundary, finishing with his bat following through over his left shoulder. Incredible

gone, but what a terrific little cameo to end his IPL career. Quick, hard length, on the stumps, and Rayudu, looking to go over long-on, ends up slicing the ball with his bat turning in his hand. No distance on it, and he pops back the simplest of return catches
dismissal: AT Rayudu c & b Sharma 19 (8m 8b 1x4 2x6) SR: 237.5

commentary: and he's gone first ball! He was out caught at extra-cover in Qualifer 1, and he's out caught at extra-cover in the final. Full, it's there to drive over extra-cover, but he doesn't get the elevation he wants, and the ball ends up in the safe hands of David Miller. What a moment
pre_text: Well, well. With 22 needed off 14 balls, MS Dhoni walks out to an absolute wall of noise. And that's just the ESPNcricinfo office I'm talking about. Ahmedabad must be absolutely exploding with Thala fever right now.
dismissal: MS Dhoni c Miller b Sharma 0 (1m 1b 0x4 0x6) SR: 0

commentary: full, slanting away from off stump, driven with an open face to the right of deep point
pre_text: What an over this has been. Pure T20. 646WW. Mohit is on a hat-trick. In walks Ravindra Jadeja. Over the wicket.

commentary: full, angling in to finish just outside off, driven to long-off
pre_text:
Nazeer: "It was Turning out to be the perfect climax to Rayudu's career. Can he still hang up his boots holding the trophy?"

Anson: "Hey what happened nooooooo"

short_text: Mohammed Shami to Dube, no run
commentary: short, angling across to finish in the corridor. Thinks of the uppercut, decides against it in the end, hoping for a wide. It isn't a wide
pre_text: 20 off 11. Over the wicket to Dube. Interesting field. Short third, and a very fine deep third.

commentary: another good short ball, ending up over Dube's back shoulder. Difficult to control the pull from there, and he ends up hitting it in the air, but lands it in the wide spaces between short fine and deep backward square leg
in the blockhole, angling in towards off stump, clipped to the right of deep midwicket
pre_text: 18 off 9. Round the wicket now.

commentary: length ball, angling in towards off stump, ends up a little cramped for room even though he clears his front leg. Drags a swipe to deep backward square leg off the inside half of his bat

full-toss, low full-toss, angling in towards off stump, and Jadeja completely mishits it. Looks to go over long-on, and ends up scooping it towards deep backward square leg. Noor runs in quickly off the rope and dives forward, but he can't reach the ball in time
perfect off-stump yorker, and all Dube can do is get his front leg out of the way and jam his bat down. Jabbed straight back to the bowler
pre_text: Whodathunk at the start of this tournament that Mohit Sharma, net bowler last season, would bowl the final over of the final, against his former team? CSK need 13 off six balls. Shivam Dube is on strike. Over the wicket.

commentary: another excellent blockhole ball, slanting across to off stump. This time Dube manages to jab it for a single down to long-off
low, unhittable full-toss on leg stump. Clears his front leg, and he tries to manufacture some sort of elevation but all he can do is hit it to long-on, on the bounce, for a single
pre_text: 12 off 4, with Ravindra Jadeja on strike. He hasn't had the greatest season with the bat, but all will be forgotten if he middles a couple of big hits.

commentary: low full-toss slanting away from off stump, and again it's too low for any elevation. Goes down the ground, hits it on the bounce to long-off. Another single
pre_text: Three incredibly good balls so far. Inch-perfect.

commentary: SIX! You only have to miss the yorker by a few inches, and you disappear. Looks for the stump yorker, lands it slightly short of where he's aiming, and ends up offering a slot ball that Jadeja launches over long-on, clean and flat. Stunning
pre_text: 10 off two balls. Mohit grabs a quick glug of water.

commentary: Jadeja's done it! CSK have won their fifth IPL title! CSK's players run onto the field as one, but MS Dhoni remains in the dugout, eyes closed. An incredible final over from Mohit Sharma ends with two marginal errors. First, an error of length, ended up as a straight six. Then an error of line. Low full-toss, but it's on the pads, and Jadeja swings at it and gets enough bat on it to get it into the gap, fine of short fine leg. What a match. Shame it's been shortened by rain, but the finish has been worth everything that went before
pre_text: Four to win, three to tie. One last ball to end a sensational tournament. Three-day final, but it's been worth all the waiting and sky-watching.
